load.custom_size: Enter the length and width of the load.
load.too_wide: The load is wider than the cargo space.
load.deck_unknown: Enter the cargo space length (or pallet places in the vehicle profile).
load.overweight: Load of {weight} kg exceeds the payload of {payload} kg.
load.cog_front: The load's centre of gravity is too far forward ({share}% of the length) – move heavier pallets back so as not to overload the fifth wheel.
load.cog_back: The load's centre of gravity is too far back ({share}% of the length) – move heavier pallets forward so the steering axle keeps its load.
load.no_front_wall: The load does not rest against the front wall – more straps are needed (braking).
load.axle_over: Axle load exceeded: {axle} {load} kg, {limit} kg allowed – move the load or reduce the weight.
load.adjusted: The load was rearranged so as not to exceed the axle loads.
load.gap_front: The load is {gap} m away from the front wall – block it at the front (beam, airbag) or add straps.
load.too_high: A stack is higher than the cargo space (about {height} m).
load.overlap: Pieces overlap – move the pallets apart.
load.wall_weak: The front wall ({wall} kN per EN 12642) cannot take {force} kN when braking – straps also counted forwards; add beams or mats.
load.too_many_straps: Too many straps per row to fit – use anti-slip mats, blocking or reduce the row weight.
load.tractor_front: Tractor front axle (estimate) {front} kg – over the allowed load; move the load back.
load.tractor_drive: Tractor drive axle (estimate) {drive} kg – over 11,500 kg; move the load back.
load.tractor_gvw: Gross combination weight (estimate) {gvw} kg – over 40,000 kg.
load.tractor_drive_share: Only {share}% of the combination weight on the drive axle (at least 25% required) – move the load forwards.
load.norm.art61: Art. 61 Polish Road Traffic Act – axle loads and GVW
load.pdf.title: Load plan
load.pdf.disclaimer: The calculations, layout and choice of securing are illustrative and supporting only (simplified formulas, typical vehicle geometry) – this is not a certificate. The driver and the loader / consignor are responsible for placing, lashing and securing the load in line with art. 61 of the Polish Road Traffic Act, the CMR Convention, EN 12195-1 and VDI 2700.
